params.body:
## What

Donor records and the secret behind a campaign's manager link are stored where they cannot be read without the server's token.

## Why

The Sanity dataset answers queries without a login; the public pages are built from it. Donor records and campaign documents sat in it under ordinary ids, so the same was true for them: names, e-mail addresses, postal addresses, the cancel tokens of monthly donors and the manager tokens of campaigns. A comment in `campaignAuth.ts` assumed the dataset was private. It is not.

Sanity makes one exception: a document whose id contains a dot can only be read with a token. This change uses that.

## How

- `src/lib/privatePath.ts`: the ids. New donor records get `donor.<uuid>`; a campaign's token lives in `campaignSecret.<slug>`.
- `create-payment.ts`: both places that create a donor use the new id.
- `campaignAuth.ts`: reads the token from the secret document first, then from the old place on the campaign document, then from `CAMPAIGN_TOKENS`. Writing only goes to the secret document and clears the old place. `campaign-create.ts`, `campaign-admin.ts`, `manage.astro` and `finance.astro` go through it.
- The `token` field on the campaign schema is hidden and marked as no longer used.
- `scripts/move-to-private-path.mjs`: moves the existing records, once per dataset. Dry run by default. It moves one donor record first and stops, leaving everything as it was, if the creation date does not survive (the finance and campaign pages order by it). The rest goes in groups where copy and removal happen together. It prints counts only and ends by checking, without a token, that nothing is readable any more.
- Smoke tests: for both datasets, no donor and no campaign secret may be readable without a login. The donor field check that relied on anonymous reading now needs `SANITY_TOKEN`.

The site reads the old and the new place, so it works before, during and after the move. Order: merge and deploy, then run the script.

## After the merge

On the server:

```
cd /var/www/afrodidact-repo && set -a && . /var/www/afrodidact/.env && set +a
node scripts/move-to-private-path.mjs --dataset testing --apply   # rehearsal
node scripts/move-to-private-path.mjs                             # counts for production
node scripts/move-to-private-path.mjs --apply
```

Then regenerate the campaign manager tokens on the finance page and hand out the new links: the current ones were readable. A finance page left open in a browser needs a reload after the move, since it holds the old donor ids.

## Checked

- `npm test` (63 pass) and `npm run build`.
- The new queries parse against Sanity.
- Not run: the script and the writes, which need the write token. Hence the rehearsal on `testing`.

## Known gap

A donor created by hand in the Studio would still get an ordinary id. The smoke test catches it.
params.title: Donor records and campaign tokens on a private path
